finalGate.summary: 150 Scenario and 110 Wording tests passed after adding the exact HTTP action-member producer fact. Fresh CreditTransfer regeneration shows concise HTTP labels and no namespace-heavy action label.

notes: This is a measured external-acceptance repair, not a broader naming project.
Independent review found canonical-debug, label-collision, and incomplete-fact gaps; all were fixed before the initial gate.

Post-gate external regeneration exposed a missing producer fact: controller action Scenario presentation carried the type but not exact method name, so the planner correctly used its type-only fallback.
The producer fact was repaired and externally verified: Web roots now render as CreditTransferController.ProcessUSSD and CreditTransferController.VirginCreditTransfer.
